svg.text: Reachability rings — how the building branches out from a single entrance
One person per room. Distance from the entrance = how deep the room sits; colour =
programme. Public & research stand near the door; production & labs are pushed deep.
top = most reachable · bottom = deepest / most isolated
How many rooms sit at each distance from the entrance?
Public and event spaces (halls, library, courtyard) and research centres sit closest to the entrance — the most reachable programmes.
Offices, faculty rooms and — deepest of all — the workshops and labs are pushed to the far edge; production stays isolated.
